text:
To determine the value of the Hubble constant, an astronomer measures the distance of a galaxy
from the Earth as 2.5 × 1021
km.
She also measures the speed of recession of the galaxy from the Earth as 5.2 × 103
km/s.
From these data, what is the value of the Hubble constant?
7.7 × 10–26
s–1
A
2.1 × 10–18
s–1
B
4.8 × 1017
s–1
C
1.3 × 1025
s–1
D
